module: "Debug" section (order 1010) of the Dynamic Decals tool: a series of test buttons for developers. They call the editor_api_dynamicDecals API (layer reprojection, brush bake, layerStack dump, material names, surface depth/normal, vehicle material update), the other modules of the tool (textures, gizmo, notification, docs, widgets, settings) and a dynamic material generator for all vehicles.
notes: The "Generate Materials" button walks /vehicles/*, reads <vehicle>/main.materials.json and, for each used material (settings.getUsedMaterialNames) whose `mapTo` matches, creates a "<name>.skin.dynamicTextures" material whose stage 2 uses the textures @DynamicTextureBaseColor / ColorPalette / Metallic / Roughness. The result is written to <vehicle>/dynamicDecals/main.materials.json: writes into game files, use with caution.
This code assumes that dynamicDecal Stages[2] exists in every material read; otherwise it raises an error.
The "Reproject Layers every frame" checkbox calls api.reprojectLayers() on every frame the section is displayed: expensive.

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Declares no preference (the body is entirely commented out).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the API and the textures, gizmo, notification, docs, widgets, settings modules, then registers the "Debug" section (order 1010).
